title: Field Trip Permission Information Sheet
subtitle: Plan the trip, document transport and supervision, and route the guardian permission decision.
description: Captures the student and guardian, trip schedule, meeting and pickup locations, transportation, activities, supervision, emergency contact, support needs, permission scope, and return handoff.
use_case: Use when school or program staff request guardian permission for a specific trip. A material change to the itinerary, transport, supervision, or return plan requires renewed communication and review. For planning or review use, cite the current itinerary, guardian wording, support plan route, communicated changes, and supersession date. Preserve the permission source, effective date, guardian question, accessibility support, amendment history, distribution list, and replaced version.
